## 📝 Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature. Highlight any architectural impact, new smart contract functions, or UI changes.

Fixes #(issue)

## 🧪 Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 🔐 Smart contract modification (`contracts/`)
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX enhancement (`frontend/`)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update

## 🏎️ Verification & Testing

- [ ] All Vitest unit tests pass (`cd frontend && npm test`)
- [ ] Smart contract tests pass (`cd contracts && cargo test --workspace`)
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly with zero errors (`cd frontend && npm run build`)
- [ ] Tested on Stellar Soroban Testnet with Freighter wallet
